rows.grounds: locative plural denoting the large number in which torment occurs
compound of yoni and yantra; locative plural indicating the spheres of embodiment
past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: What vast range of womb-mechanisms subjects beings to torment?
premises: The number involved is eighty-four thousand.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense multiplicity of womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
